product.description: The VortexTech UltraPrime 85mm f/1.8 is a high‑performance prime lens designed for portrait and low‑light photography. It features a fast f/1.8 aperture that delivers shallow depth of field and excellent bokeh. The lens barrel is constructed from lightweight aluminum with a rubberized focus ring for tactile control. Integrated optical image stabilization compensates for handheld shake, while a multi‑layer anti‑reflection coating reduces flare and ghosting. Compatible with a range of Canon mirrorless and DSLR bodies, it offers crisp image quality and smooth autofocus across its focal length. The lens is packaged with a protective case and a quick‑release mounting plate for versatile use on tripods or handheld.
